name: Data Product Owners
description: Accountable and responsible contacts for this Data Product.

properties.name: Business Owner
properties.description: The person accountable for this Data Product's business value and lifecycle decisions.

properties.name: Technical Owner / Data Steward
properties.description: The engineer or steward responsible for the pipelines, schema and data quality.

properties.name: Department / Domain Team
properties.description: The business unit or team this Data Product belongs to.

properties.name: Support Contact
properties.description: Primary channel for questions or issues with this Data Product.

properties.name: Escalation Contact
properties.description: Secondary contact for incidents or SLA breaches.

name: Data Product Details
description: Classification, lifecycle and operational metadata for this Data Product.

properties.name: Domain
properties.description: Business domain this Data Product belongs to.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Semantic version of this Data Product / its contract.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Lifecycle status of this Data Product.

properties.name: Data Classification
properties.description: Sensitivity level of the data exposed by this Data Product.

properties.name: Refresh Frequency
properties.description: How often the underlying data is refreshed (SLA).

properties.name: Certification Tier
properties.description: Quality/trust tier assigned to this Data Product.

properties.name: Source Systems
properties.description: Originating systems feeding this Data Product.
properties.defaultValue: e.g. ERP, Clinical Trials DB, BNF reference data

properties.name: Usage Terms / License
properties.description: Restrictions or terms of use for this Data Product.
properties.defaultValue: ⚠️ Internal use only unless otherwise approved by Data Governance.

properties.name: Retention Period
properties.description: How long the underlying data is retained.
